info.title: Standing Mark
info.description: Standing Mark is an independent examination service operated by Wheeler Hubbell Publishing, Inc. It examines claims and proposed actions and returns a signed result stating what is established and what is not. It does not execute, authorize, pay or settle.
info.x-guidance: GET /v1/contract first; it is the live source of truth for schemas, payment terms and limits, including the accepted input schema (input_schema). POST /v1/evaluate with a JSON body in that input schema: the proposition as a string 'claim' (or 'subject' or object.id), the examination material as a string 'data', provenance.source, provenance.evidence and an authority warrant as applicable. An object-valued 'claim' is not a proposition and no field named 'material' is read. An unpaid request returns HTTP 402 with a fixed-price payment request for exactly 1.00 USDC on Base (scheme WHP-BASE-USDC-FLAT-1, not x402-exact): the quote carries quote_id, amount_units, pay_to and expires, and is bound to the exact request bytes. Pay the quoted amount on Base, then retry the identical body with headers X-WHP-Quote and X-WHP-Payment-Tx. POST /v1/verification checks a signed result's signature only. The issuer Ed25519 key is published at /.well-known/whp-issuer.json.

get.summary: Current machine-readable contract: schemas, payment terms and limits
Issuer identity: Ed25519 public key and key id

post.summary: Submit a claim or proposed action for examination
post.description: Without payment, returns HTTP 402 with a price quote bound to the exact request bytes. After paying the quoted amount of USDC on Base, retry the identical body with headers X-WHP-Quote (the quote id) and X-WHP-Payment-Tx (the Base transaction hash) to receive the signed examination result. Payment buys the examination, not a positive finding.

oneOf.description: A JSON string body is treated as the claim.

The examination request in the accepted input schema (authoritative copy: GET /v1/contract, field input_schema). The evaluator reads only these fields. Strict JSON: safe integers only (no floats, no -0, no integers beyond +/-2^53-1), no duplicate keys, well-formed Unicode, at most 64 levels deep and 262144 bytes. An object-valued 'claim' is not a proposition; no field named 'material' is read; a request with no readable proposition and no readable material is examined over zero bytes.

claim.description: The proposition examined. When no 'data' string is supplied, the claim itself is the examined material (explicit recorded fallback).

subject.description: The proposition when no claim string is present.

data.description: The examination material read against the proposition.

source.description: A retrievable source reference for the material ('provenance.source' is also read).
A retrievable source reference for the material.

authority.description: The authority warrant; required for operations crossing the decision boundary (RECOMMEND and above). A top-level 'warrant' string is also read.

requested_operation.description: Default INFORM; ACT is read as EXECUTE.

unknowns.description: Declared unknowns, each may name operations it blocks.

nodes.description: Signed attestation nodes; a complete WHP-STANDING-SUBMISSION-v1 object is also accepted.

schema.description: The claim or proposed action to examine, with supporting material. Field-level requirements are defined in the live contract at GET /v1/contract (input_schema); the quote is bound to the exact request bytes.

200.description: Signed examination result: a Standing Mark (claim established) or a signed record naming what is not established

402.description: Payment required. The body carries a price quote bound to the exact request bytes, under payment_required.

503.description: Payment chain temporarily unavailable (CHAIN_UNAVAILABLE); nothing is consumed

post.description: Signature check only. Per the live contract this route does not authenticate the supplied key or establish object binding; full independent verification uses the published issuer key and the standalone receiver.

schema.description: A signed result previously returned by /v1/evaluate

Contract.description: Live contract: profile, routes, payment terms, determinism rule, signed type, issuer key and limits. Read at time of use.

Quote.description: Price quote bound to the exact request bytes. Self-expires (observed lifetime about 15 minutes).

amount_units.description: Exactly 1000000 USDC atomic units (1.00 USDC, 6 decimals)

SignedResult.description: Signed examination result. Type WHP-STANDING-MARK-v1, Ed25519 signature by the published issuer key. Either a Standing Mark (ESTABLISHED) or a signed record naming what is not established.
